document.abstract: Since the last report, this Committee has concentrated its efforts on the preparation of data for a new issue of the Standards Booklet. Much new material has been included, and some of the data contained in the old booklet have been rearranged and amplified. The material for the new booklet will be published in an early issue of the JOURNAL, and will contain data on cutting and perforating dimensions of raw stock with tolerances, for 35- and 16-mm. sizes. Charts showing dimensions and location of camera and projector apertures, and sound track location for 35-mm. and 16-mm. sound film will be included. The standard 35-mm. sprocket specifications have been revised.
